title: In the aircraft about 200 meters from a class 8 object, nobody sees it
place_text: Airborne near the El Paso area

tellings.quote: And I know they don't They see, because I was, probably 200 meters away from an 8th class object,

plain: In 2025, flying near El Paso, James Valor says he was about 200 meters from what he calls a class 8 object, one of the highest ranks on his own scale of strange craft, and nobody else in the aircraft saw it. Valor tells this as the one who was there. He works with Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, and he uses it to argue that people can be right next to such things and still not see them.
